# Boris Anyama, MD

> Professional profile for Boris Anyama, MD, a board-certified anesthesiologist, interventional pain physician, medical educator, and former Atlanta Falcons linebacker.

Dr. Anyama is an Assistant Professor at the University of Pittsburgh School of Medicine. His work spans anesthesiology, interventional pain medicine, medical education, mentorship, speaking, and community leadership.

## Profile

- [About](https://drborisanyama.com/#about): Biography and transition from Division I and professional football to medicine.
- [Clinical work](https://drborisanyama.com/#clinical-work): Anesthesiology, interventional pain medicine, multimodal care, and neuromodulation.
- [Teaching](https://drborisanyama.com/#teaching): Medical education, mentorship, lectures, grand rounds, and journal clubs.
- [Speaking](https://drborisanyama.com/#speaking): Performance, medicine, identity, recovery, and professional transition.
- [Leadership](https://drborisanyama.com/#leadership): NFL former-player, regional, and professional service.
- [Scholarship](https://drborisanyama.com/#scholarship): Selected peer-reviewed publications.
